mode: generate with two local reference images
prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: shared material-style atlas for a 6x6 illustrated mystery puzzle board.

Input images:
- Image 1 is the desired board reference. Use its simplified floor language: flat pastel color fields, sparse hand-drawn plank or stone seams, low contrast, no realism.
- Image 2 is the locked object style master. Match its muted sage, dusty mauve, honey beige, pale blue-gray, charcoal-purple family and its soft cel-shaded illustration character.

Primary request: create one clean 3-column by 2-row atlas containing exactly six large rectangular material swatches, separated by wide plain warm-off-white gutters. No labels and no text.

Swatches, left to right:
Top row:
1. muted sage garden surface with a few large simple leaf/grass marks;
2. pale honey-beige wooden planks with sparse straight hand-drawn seams;
3. dusty muted lavender-brown wooden planks, clearly darker than swatch 2 but still medium-light.
Bottom row:
4. pale blue-gray courtyard stone slabs with large rounded rectangular seams;
5. warm taupe workshop stone with a few broad irregular slab seams;
6. warm muted terracotta-honey wood planks, between orange and brown but not saturated.

Style/medium: clean 2D hand-drawn board-game background material; flat fills; one subtle tone variation only; slightly imperfect hand-inked seams; very low detail; no object outlines around the outer swatch.

Composition: exact 3x2 atlas, six equally sized swatches, wide straight gutters so every swatch can be cropped safely. Each swatch fills its own rectangle edge to edge internally and contains only one material.

Lighting/value: bright diffuse ambient light, medium-light values, soft contrast, no cast shadows, no vignette, no directional highlights.

Constraints: no furniture, no plants, no rugs, no fountains, no people, no room walls, no perspective rooms, no grid coordinates, no labels, no text. Avoid photorealism, detailed grain, oil-paint texture, glossy reflections, dirt, moss noise, and dark muddy colors.
